description.html: Quartz sand is a fine, light-colored substrate that gives an aquarium a clean, natural look. Quartz is chemically neutral, so it does not change the pH or hardness of the water and can be used in any freshwater aquarium. The colors of fish and plants stand out nicely against the light bottom.

The fine grain suits fish that like to dig through the bottom or rest on it, and plants root easily in it. The sand can be combined with coarser gravel, for example for paths or the front of the aquarium.

Before use, rinse the sand several times under running water until the water runs clear, so the dust does not cloud the aquarium. Spread it across the bottom and pour the water in slowly, over a plate or a bag, so you do not stir up the sand. The 1 kg pack is enough for a small aquarium, topping up an existing bottom or decorative details. During regular maintenance, lightly clean the surface with a gravel vacuum.
